card.name: Linking words in external heat warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "as" and "including" inside lists of external heat sources, like heating pads, electric blankets and hair dryers. Mostly in transdermal patch heat-exposure warnings.

modes.label: Heat source lists
modes.description: The word "as", "or" or "including" just before the next heat device in a list of heat sources.

modes.description: Verbs or articles in instructions to avoid heat exposure or hot items.
modes.example: don't use<< a>> sauna or take a very hot bath.
